dialogues.speaker: Taisiya
dialogues.text: A long time ago... I took part in a banquet here. That day, I even saw His Majesty the Belyi Tsar with my own two eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Pletnev
dialogues.text: Good heavens, Taisiia. Look at these decorations...

dialogues.speaker: Pletnev
dialogues.text: Now I have a feeling the candlesticks over there might be older than I am... My goodness...

dialogues.speaker: Taisiya
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, cut it out... or at least stop talking so loud, or I shall have to pretend that we are not acquainted!
